newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: HOYTS CINEMAS SHARES TOP ASX TURNOVER.
newsitem.headline: HOYTS CINEMAS SHARES TOP ASX TURNOVER.

text.p: Shares in Hoyts Cinemas Ltd topped the turnover lists on Tuesday, as almost five percent of its shares were traded.

At 3.45 p.m. (0545 GMT), Hoyts shares were two cents up at A$2.87 with 11.76 million shares traded or about 4.8 percent of the cinema group's issued capital. Earlier SBC Warburg crossed 11.6 million Hoyts shares at A$2.65 per share.
SBC Warburg, which is the underwriter to the recently announced A$95 million Hoyts rights issue, was also behind the 14.76 million rights that were crossed at 25 cents each.
Brokers said they were not sure who was the seller or buyer, but added it may be Lend Lease Corp Ltd selling its stake further.
Last week, Lend Lease sold eight million Hoyts shares reducing its stake to about five percent from 9.6 percent previously.
On July 23, when Hoyts announced its rights issue, it said Lend Lease would sell its rights.
